::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[Latex's verbatim: how to indent every instance?](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/2143687/latexs-verbatim-how-to-indent-every-instance), asked by [carl](https://stackoverflow.com/users/82322/carl) on Stack Overflow (2010-01-27; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I have a latex document with a bunch of verbatim text. I would like to indent every single instance of these. 
>
> For example:
>
> ```latex
> This is regular text.
> \begin{verbatim}
> This is verbatim text.
> \end{verbatim}
> ```
>
> I want "This is verbatim text" to be indented a centimeter or two. How do I do this?
:::

You might be interested in this because you are formatting a lot of program code.  If so, consider the [`listings`](http://ctan.org/pkg/listings) package.
